description: This file contains functions for upgrading a Netgear Orbi device on an IPQ40XX platform. It includes routines to verify dependencies, extract firmware components from a tar archive, flash kernel and root filesystem partitions, and handle loop device setup for the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that orchestrates device upgrade by verifying tools, locating partitions, flashing firmware, and rebooting.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Handles the actual flashing process: extracts kernel and root filesystem, sets up loopback devices, formats new partitions, and copies configuration backups.
